Stratford ON Canada JOB POSTING INFORMATION Placement Term <b> Job Title <b> Position Type Job Location Country Duration Work Mode Salary Currency Salary Salary Range $ Job Description Our Offering 2026 - Summer S26 Co-Op/Intern - Automated Gauging Systems (May 2026; Aerospace) - 16 months 178759B Co-op Position Stratford, ON Canada 16 months In-Person CAD 0.0 per hour for 0 Major List $23.60 to $32.20 per hour • Competitive wages - Range: $23.60 to $32.20 per hour (wage is assigned based on year of schooling completed); • Employee Discount programs are available for all employees; • Clean, bright and climate-controlled production areas. • This posting is for an existing vacancy; • AI is not used to review candidates. Your Key Responsibilities As Intern - Production Technology - Automated Gauging Systems, you will become an expert in the Renishaw Equator automated gauging system as well as Zeiss coordinate measurement machines (CMM's). You will play a crucial role in our quality control and setup time reduction measures. Collaborating closely with engineering, production and quality control teams, you will develop and optimize CMM and Renishaw equator programs tailored to the capabilities of the Renishaw Equator system - Analyze component drawings and machining programs to create measurement plans for each component. Work with the CMM inspection team to create CMM programs for each component. -Translate CMM master programs into Renishaw Modus language, divide out programs to match machining sequence, physically set up programs on the equator, optimize and prove out. -Apply advanced metrology techniques supported by Renishaw Equator technology. -Work with production to prove out new programs in real world production runs. -Further develop system capabilities and troubleshoot issues. -Implement error proofing techniques to limit scrap risk. - Procure component masters. - Document CMM programs, procedures, and inspection results specific to the Renishaw Equator system. - Generate reports detailing progress towards program creation goals. Job Requirements Your Qualifications - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. - Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java. - Familiarity with software development tools and practices. - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. - Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. - Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
